description: text-align places a line of text, inherited, and a button's own left alignment wins over its centered default

florui.css: .col { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 5px; background-color: #101117; color: #fff; width: 360px; } .c { text-align: center; width: 200px; background-color: #345; } .r { text-align: right; width: 200px; background-color: #354; } .inh { text-align: center; width: 200px; background-color: #445; } .left { text-align: left; width: 200px; height: 30px; border: none; background-color: #543; color: #fff; } .mid { width: 200px; height: 30px; border: none; background-color: #534; color: #fff; }

classification.reason: Placement matches Chromium; the remaining difference (about 1.9% of pixels measured) is the glyph rasterization of the two engines, and a line left unaligned measures about 4%.
